_comment: Force CommonJS scope for ts-node compatibility. The O-5 Workspace Gateway (oblivions/editor-next/server/) imports atomic-publisher.ts / change-set.ts / file-revision.ts via require() at runtime. editor-next/package.json has 'type': 'module', which would make Node.js treat .ts files here as ESM and break require(). This override scopes just this directory to CommonJS. Vite/vue-tsc use bundler resolution and are unaffected.
